9.reason: Group 9 is Limits/Performance: each case sends 1000 messages of DATALEN as fast as the peer will take them and the suite marks the case FAILED when the agent cannot sustain the rate. The cases that pass are the 1024-byte ones (9.1.1, 9.2.1); every case the compiled cap admits at 16384 bytes or above fails, and the boundary is the payload size rather than the message cap, because group 1's 65536-byte cases pass -- the same bytes over a low rate are conformant and only the burst is not. This is a throughput property of the engine route's read path: the inbound ring holds 64 messages and the Node main thread drains it, so a burst of 1000 messages at 16 KiB or 64 KiB outruns the consumer. It is recorded here rather than tuned, because the fix is the engine thread's drain rather than a protocol change, and a rate the pinned build cannot hold is a fact about the build. Not expected to pass on its own: it will move only when the drain does.
